changes: A Start screen when Vellum opens: continue the last drawing, pick a recent file, or start a new figure in a journal size or your own size and scale.
What's new: the status bar tells you when a new version is out, with what changed, and Download, Later or Skip this version.
Report a bug: circle the problem on a screenshot of the window and open a GitHub issue already filled in; the screenshot goes to the clipboard to paste in.
A failed download now says so, not that the check for updates failed.
